targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "ventobserve_history")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["thingId"] == "org.openegiz.ventobserve:V7")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value_methane_properties_value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
